quote: “Now, the Commission finds that the U.S. is dangerously close to falling behind China.” The report lays out six pillars for action and makes 49 recommendations.
attribution: National Security Commission on Emerging Biotechnology, press release for the final report “Charting the Future of Biotechnology”, 8 April 2025. Chair Sen. Todd Young: “Biotechnology is now an imperative for national security, economic power, and global influence.”
quote_source: Verified 2026-09-06 against https://www.biotech.senate.gov/press-releases/nsceb-publishes-final-report/ (exact sentences). The widely reported ‘at least $15 billion over five years’ figure was not on that page; confirm it in the full report PDF (biotech.senate.gov, NSCEB-Full-Report 4.28) before saying it aloud.
dtx_line: DTX Ventures, public thesis: “America's leadership in critical technologies will determine the global balance of power by 2035” across AI, AGI, energy independence, defense, space, semiconductors, supply chains and health; founders it backs “convert mission into market share” (dtxventures.com/vision).
